title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion
description: At 2023-10-01T11:45Z, prod-db-02 experienced a FATAL error indicating 'too many connections at 47/50'. Suspect connection leaks following deployment CHG-8856. Postgresql configuration max_connections set to 50.
resolution_steps: Review recent changelogs for deployment CHG-8856.
Increase max_connections setting in postgresql.conf if necessary, and restart the service.
Monitor logs to identify repeated connection leaks.

title: Redis Service Connectivity Failure Post-restart
description: At 2023-09-22T11:45Z, Redis service on prod-db-02 went down with ERR-NGINX-001. Log snippet shows 'connect() failed (111): Connection refused by server' shortly after the system restart that occurred at 10:30 AM due to routine maintenance KB-0002. Cross-check network connectivity and firewall settings.
resolution_steps: Validate network connectivity between prod-db-02 and Redis.
Review firewall rules to ensure proper access for inbound connections from Nginx.

title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhausted on prod-db-02
description: At timestamp T+0000-04-14T03:22Z, postgresql service on server 'prod-db-02' encountered FATAL error ERR-SYS-003 due to an exhausted connection pool. The observed metric indicated 47 active connections out of a maximum threshold of 50 ('max_connections=50 in postgresql.conf'). This issue potentially correlates with recent deployment CHG-8834 which may have caused unintended increases in concurrent database requests.
resolution_steps: Review recent changes, especially CHG-8834 deployment for unintended increases in concurrent database requests.
Monitor the 'max_connections' setting and connection pool usage to establish an optimal value that maintains system performance without causing exhaustion.
